doorman.text: Evening. Welcome to the Palace. You're old enough, aren't you?

then.text: Course you are. I've an eye for these things. (He winks.) In you go, and mind the carpet. It's older than both of us.

else.text: (He winks.) I'll take that as a yes. Nobody gets carded on my shift, they get a word to the wise.

doorman.text: Chips from the cage, games on the floor, and if you're losing, the sea air outside is free.

cashier.text: Buying or cashing in? Notes through the gap, chips back under. Lovely.

change_attendant.text: The fruit machines. Hold the ones you like, nudge the ones you don't, and never trust a lemon.

croupier.text: Single zero, European wheel. Place your bets, and no touching the ball, it's shy.

dealer.text: Blackjack pays three to two, and I stand on seventeen. Pull up a stool.

hilo_host.text: Higher or lower! Guess right and the pot grows. Guess wrong and, well. Didn't they do well?

then.text: Set the limit, and keep the number. That's all I'll say.

else.text: Between us, the roulette wheel has 37 pockets and pays as if there were 36. That green zero is the house's cut: about 2.7p in every pound, and the longer you play the surer it gets.
The fruit machines are the same sum in a flashier coat. Set your limit at the door, and leave when you reach it.
If it stops being fun, we have leaflets by the cage. On the mainland, in Great Britain, the National Gambling Helpline is 0808 8020 133. Free, confidential, any hour.
I'd rather lose your custom than see you lose the rent. Here, have a pie. The Island's finest.
Noted in the Almanac under Things worth knowing.
